description: LIMA AI is the NVDA add-on companion to the LIMA (Low-Vision Intelligent Machine Assistant) desktop app. Press a shortcut and NVDA speaks a brief AI description of the active screen or of the control you are focused on, ask follow-up questions about it, click any on-screen control just by describing it, toggle live narration of changes on a web page, and check how much of your monthly credit you have used. Replies can be in English, Tagalog, or Vietnamese.
changelog: New: NVDA+Alt+E opens the description in its own window, where you can reread it, copy it and ask follow-up questions. New: NVDA+Alt+A opens LIMA AI settings to sign in or out. LIMA AI now says why a sign-in or a new account was refused, and when the server is busy or slow. Credit usage shows two decimal places.
